dialogues.speaker: Ancient Engravings
dialogues.text: "...By order of Legio V's special envoy, Faunus, the northern harbor defensive line has been withdrawn, and defenses have been set up in the direction of Caesareum Palace in their place..."

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Engravings
dialogues.text: "...The flank is to be defended by Legio IX. It is only necessary to ensure that there is no frontal breakthrough... (indiscernible) has dispatched several centuries of troops... Unlike the scheming savages, the Dragonborn use no tactics. Merely..."
